turn_text: Congressman King, what about the sugar program? It seems to be very different than the others that are within the bill. How did it survive this go around?

It's when you look at the global markets and see the countries that produce sugar in the way they subsidize and manipulate the markets, It puts our U.S. sugar producers at a significant disadvantage. But the sugar producers are at a distinct disadvantage because other states or other countries are so much manipulating the markets and subsidizing their sugar. And one of the most extreme that I recall, and Cuba's fallen off of the list of major sugar producers, but I recall distortion in there. product down there.
